original: あー、だりぃ
traducao: Man, what a drag.

original: ガイ。\n何か面白い事ねぇのかよ
traducao: Guy.\nIsn't there anything fun to do?

original: またルークの退屈病が始まったな
traducao: There goes Luke's boredom bug again.

original: ルーク、時間は有効に活用するべきよ
traducao: Luke, you should use your time wisely.

original: この機会に、普段やらない事に\n挑戦してみるというのはどうかしら
traducao: Why not take this chance to try\nsomething you don't usually do?

original: お、それはいいかもしれないな
traducao: Oh, that might not be a bad idea.

original: 料理なんてどうだ、ルーク？\n楽しいぞ
traducao: How about cooking, Luke?\nIt's quite fun.

original: 何だ、メシの時間か？\nコーダは腹が減ったぞ、しかし
traducao: What's this, time to eat?\nCoda's tummy is empty, however!

original: 何だぁ？　このアホザル
traducao: What's with this dumb monkey?

original: こいつは……。\n確か、イリアの飼ってるサルか？
traducao: This little guy is...\nIsn't he the monkey Iria keeps?

original: （大きな耳……かわいい……）
traducao: (Those big ears... so cute...)

original: メシはいつ出るんだ？　しかし
traducao: When is food served, however?!

original: 飯なんて出ねぇよ、アホザル
traducao: No food is being served, dumb monkey.

original: コーダは、クレアの\nピーチパイが好物なんだな、しかし
traducao: Coda loves Claire's peach pie\nthe best, however!

original: うっせー！
traducao: Shut up!

original: お前！\nいちいち喋りがうぜーっつーの！！
traducao: Hey, you!\nYour voice is annoying, you hear me?!

original: はっ。\n美味そうな匂い……
traducao: Gasp!\nA delicious smell...

original: あっちなんだな、しかし！
traducao: It's over there, however!

original: てめ、待ちやがれ、このアホザル！！
traducao: Hey, get back here, you dumb monkey!!

original: やれやれ……。\nいい退屈しのぎにはなるか？
traducao: Good grief...\nI guess that helps kill some boredom?

original: ご飯があれば……、\n触らせてくれるかしら……
traducao: If I had food...\nwould he let me pet him, I wonder...?

original: おいおい
traducao: Hey now.
Kwi..., kw...

original: クィッキーーー！
traducao: Quickieee---!

original: キュ？\nどうしたキュ？
traducao: Kyu?\nWhat's wrong, kyu?

original: ク……、クィッキ……
traducao: Kw..., Quickie...

original: あ、あそこに黒くて\nカサカサ動いている虫がいるキュ！
traducao: Th-There's a black, creepy-crawly\nbug over there, kyu!

original: あれが怖いだキュ？\nそれならキュッポに任せるキュ！
traducao: Are you scared of that, kyu?\nLeave it to Kyuppo, kyu!

original: もう大丈夫だキュ
traducao: It's all safe now, kyu.

original: さすがはキュッポ兄さんだキュ
traducao: As expected of Big Brother Kyuppo, kyu!

original: 勝利のダンス、開始だキュ！
traducao: Time for our victory dance, kyu!

original: キュ〜キュキュ〜キュ〜キュキュッキュ〜♪\nキュキュキュ♪　キュキュキュ♪\nキュキュキュッキュ！
traducao: Kyu~ kyu-kyu~ kyu~ kyu-kyu-kyu~!\nKyu-kyu-kyu! Kyu-kyu-kyu!\nKyu-kyu-kyu-kyu!

original: クィ〜、クィクィ〜クククィッキ〜♪\nクィクィクィ♪　クィッキ〜〜♪
traducao: Kwi~, kwi-kwi~ k-k-Quickie~!\nKwi-kwi-kwi! Quickie~~!

original: 全く、騒がしいぞ、しかし
traducao: Good grief, so noisy, however!

original: キュキュ〜♪
traducao: Kyu-kyu~!

original: クィッキ〜〜♪
traducao: Quickie~~!

original: コーダが騒がしいと言っているのに\n踊るのをやめないのか？　しかし
traducao: Even though Coda said it's noisy,\nyou won't stop dancing, however?!

original: うるせーぞ、このアホザル！！
traducao: Shut up, you dumb monkey!!
Kwiiiiii...

original: ひどいな。\nお前のペットとは違うぞ、しかし
traducao: How cruel.\nI'm not your pet, however!

original: んなもん、かんけーねぇってーの！\nうぜぇもんは、うぜぇんだよ！！
traducao: Like that matters at all!\nAnnoying is annoying!!

original: 「しばらくバンエルティア号っつー船で\n　世話んなる事になった」
traducao: I've ended up staying on a ship\ncalled the Van Eltia for a while.

original: 「久々に好き勝手動けるかと思ったら\n　ギルドの仕事が回ってこねーと\n　外に出たらダメらしい」
traducao: I thought I'd finally do as I please,\nbut without a guild job assigned,\nit seems I can't even go outside.

original: 「ちぇっ、つまんねー」
traducao: Tch, so boring.

original: 「ただ、ヴァン師匠も一緒だし、\n　暇な時剣の稽古もつけるって\n　約束してくれたから」
traducao: Still, Master Van is here too,\nand he promised to train me\nin swordsmanship when free.

original: 「それはちょっとラッキーだったな。\n　へへっ」
traducao: So that was pretty lucky.\nHeheh.

original: 「いけすかねーアッシュもいるが、少なくとも\n　城ン中に閉じ込められてる生活よりか\n　だいぶマシかもしんねーな」
traducao: That obnoxious Asch is here too, but\nthis is way better than being locked\nup inside the manor.

original: ……ふう。\nこんなもんか？
traducao: ...Phew.\nGuess that's good enough?

original: よおルーク、遊びに来たぜ〜
traducao: Yo Luke, I came over to hang out~!

original: おっ。\n何書いてんだ？　\n日記か？
traducao: Oho.\nWhatcha writing?\nA diary?

original: ！！\nば、ばか、見るな！
traducao: !!\nId-Idiot, don't look!

original: つか、勝手に入ってくんじゃねー！
traducao: Don't just barge in without asking!

original: ルーク！\nすみません、少しいいです？
traducao: Luke!\nExcuse me, do you have a moment?

original: あ？　\nなんだ、エステルか
traducao: Huh?\nOh, it's just you, Estelle.

original: 何の用だよ
traducao: What do you want?

original: あの……わたしの気のせいかもしれませんが\n最近、ナタリアの元気がない様な\n気がするんです
traducao: Um... this might just be my imagination,\nbut lately Natalia doesn't seem\nto be feeling quite herself.

original: 何か、心当たりはありませんか？
traducao: Do you have any idea what it could be?

original: え？\n……別に、知らねえよ
traducao: Huh?\n...I don't know anything about that.

original: 変なモンでも食って\n腹壊してるとかじゃねーのか？
traducao: Didn't she just eat something weird\nand upset her stomach?

original: それはないと思いますけど……
traducao: I don't believe that's the case...

original: ……やっぱり、わたしの勘違いかも\nしれませんね。\n変な事聞いてすみませんでした
traducao: ...Perhaps I was mistaken after all.\nI'm sorry for asking such an odd\nquestion.

original: ったく……俺が知るわけねーだろっつの。\nあいつ、そういうの何にも\n話さねーんだからよ
traducao: Jeez... How would I know, anyway?\nShe never talks about that kind of\nstuff with me.

original: だーーっ、もう！\n何で俺がモヤモヤしなくちゃなんねーんだ！\nくそっ
traducao: Argh, damn it!\nWhy do I have to feel so uneasy now?!\nCrap!

original: ……しょうがねえ。\nちっと確かめてみるか……
traducao: ...Guess I've got no choice.\nI'll go check on her a bit...

original: お、っと……とととと
traducao: Whoa, wh-whoa-whoa-whoa!

original: おわ！　\n危ねぇ！
traducao: Whoa!\nWatch it!

original: チッ。\nんだよ、ブタ執事。\nどこ見て歩いてんだよ！
traducao: Tch.\nWhat gives, pig butler?!\nWatch where you're walking!

original: も、申し訳……ありません。\n何でも、ありません……ので
traducao: I-I am terribly... sorry.\nIt's nothing... at all, really.

original: おい、本当に大丈夫か？\n顔色が真っ青じゃないか
traducao: Hey, are you really okay?\nYou look as pale as a ghost.

original: 大丈夫です……
traducao: I am quite fine...

original: あう……
traducao: Auu...

original: 何だぁ？\n腹減ってんのかよ
traducao: What?\nAre you just hungry?

original: ったく、しょうがねーな
traducao: Sheesh, what am I gonna do with you.

original: おらよ。\nこれでも食ってろ
traducao: Here.\nEat this instead.

original: つってもまぁ、あんま腹の足しには\nなんねーと思うけどな
traducao: Not that I think it'll fill\nyour belly much, though.

original: ビスケット……
traducao: A biscuit...

original: でも……
もらっておけよ。\nこれでも、ルークなりに\n気を遣ってるんだ
traducao: Just take it.\nThis is Luke's own way\nof showing consideration.

original: ガイ！\n余計な事言うなっつーの！
traducao: Guy!\nKeep your mouth shut, will you?!

original: 心配……して下さったんですか
traducao: You were... worried about me?

original: ありがとうございます
traducao: Thank you.

original: 別に、そんなんじゃねーよ
traducao: It's not like that at all.

original: ただお前、たまに飯食わないで\n仕事してんだろ
traducao: You just skip meals to work\nsometimes, right?

original: 程々にしとけよ。\nそんでぶっ倒れられたら、\nそれこそこっちが迷惑だからな
traducao: Don't overdo it.\nIf you collapse on the job,\nit'll only inconvenience us.

original: ははは。\n相変わらず素直じゃないねえ
traducao: Hahaha.\nStill not honest with yourself, huh?

original: （ガイ様が、ルーク様にお仕えする理由……。\n　何だかわかった気がします）
traducao: (I think I understand why Master Guy)\n(chooses to serve Master Luke.)

original: よお、お坊ちゃま！\nどした、そんな楽しそうな顔して
traducao: Yo, young master!\nWhy the cheerful look on your face?

original: これのどこが楽しそうな顔に見えんだよ！\nお前バカだろ！
traducao: How does this look cheerful to you?!\nAre you an idiot?!

original: はは、案外当たってるぜ、それ
traducao: Haha, that might actually be on point.

original: 腹減ってイライラしてる時に\n余計な事言うんじゃねぇよ！
traducao: Don't bother me with your nonsense\nwhen I'm starving and annoyed!

original: 腹減ってるって\nさっき飯食ったばっかじゃねぇか？
traducao: Starving?\nDidn't you just finish eating a bit ago?

original: はん！　\nあんなしょぼい飯、\n俺の口に合うわけねぇだろうが
traducao: Hmph!\nA pitiful meal like that could never\nsatisfy my tastes!

original: そうだお前、ちょうどいい！
traducao: Oh right, you'll do nicely!

original: おい。\n俺の口に合う飯を買って来いよ！
traducao: Hey.\nGo buy me food that fits my palate!

original: はは、面白い事言うお坊ちゃんだな。\nんで、どこで買って来いってんだ？
traducao: Haha, aren't you a funny rich boy?\nAnd just where am I supposed to buy it?

original: んなもん、自分で考えろっつーの。\n金なら幾らでもあんだから、\nちゃっちゃと行って買って来い！
traducao: Figure that out yourself!\nI've got plenty of money,\nso hurry up and go buy it!

original: そんなに大金を所持してんなら\nご自分のお眼鏡にかなうコックでも\n雇ってくりゃいいんじゃないのかね
traducao: If you've got so much cash on hand,\nwhy don't you hire a chef who meets\nyour high standards?

original: お前、バカか？\nこんな空の上で、どうやって\nコックを見つけて来いってんだよ！
traducao: Are you an idiot?!\nHow am I supposed to find a chef\nall the way up in the sky?!

original: そうだよなぁ〜。\nこんな空の上だもんなあ
traducao: Ain't that the truth~.\nWe're way up in the sky, after all.

original: という事は、ご馳走を揃えるってのも\n到底無理な相談だよな
traducao: Which means getting a gourmet feast\nis completely out of the question.

original: む……、ぐぐぐ……
traducao: Ngh... grrr...

original: うっせぇー！\nちょっと、俺が\n言い間違えただけだろうが！
traducao: Shut up!\nI just slipped up and misspoke\na little, that's all!

original: いいから、どうにか飯を\n旨くしてくれりゃいいんだよ！\nお前ならそれぐらい出来んだろ！
traducao: Just do something to make the food\ntaste better! A guy like you oughta\nbe able to handle that much!

original: いいか、俺はお前に頼んだからな！\n忘れんなよ！！
traducao: Remember, I asked you to do this!\nDon't you forget it!!

original: へいへい、わかったわかった。\n考えとくよ、お坊ちゃま
traducao: Yeah, yeah, I hear ya.\nI'll give it some thought, young master.

original: へえ……。\n意外に、自分の間違いも\n素直に認められんだな
traducao: Heh...\nSurprising how honestly he can admit\nwhen he's made a mistake.

original: 最初に思った程\nお子様じゃないって事なのかね
traducao: Maybe he's not quite as much of a brat\nas I first thought.

original: そういやルークって、\nどうして日記を始めようと思ったんだ？
traducao: By the way, Luke, what made you\ndecide to start keeping a diary?

original: ああ？
traducao: Huh?

original: どうしてそんな事、わざわざお前に\n教えてやんなきゃなんねーんだよ
traducao: Why the hell should I bother\ntelling you something like that?

original: だってよ、ルークって\nそういうマメな事しなさそうっていうか\n結構律儀な奴なんだなぁって思ってさ
traducao: Well, you don't seem like the type\nfor diligent stuff, so I figured\nyou're actually pretty methodical!

original: そんなんじゃねーよ。\nガキの頃からのつまんねー習慣が\n今も何となく続いてるだけだ……
traducao: It's nothing like that.\nIt's just a stupid habit from childhood\nthat somehow kept going...

original: って事は、結構長く\n日記付けてるって事だよな？
traducao: Which means you've been keeping\na diary for a pretty long time, right?

original: やっぱルークってマメなんだなぁ！
traducao: You really are diligent, Luke!

original: だ、だから\nそんなんじゃねーっつーの！！
traducao: I-I told you,\nthat's not it at all!!

original: おい、ウッドロウじゃねえか！？
traducao: Hey, if it isn't Woodrow?!

original: ちょっと、ルーク！？
traducao: Hold on, Luke?!

original: やっぱそうだ！
traducao: It really is you!

original: 何だよ、お前もこのギルドで\n働く事んなったのか？
traducao: What, did you end up working\nfor this guild too?

original: ああ、実は成り行きで、そうなってね
traducao: Yes, as circumstances would have it.

original: 久しぶりだな、ルーク君。\n変わりない様で何よりだ
traducao: It has been a while, Luke.\nI am glad to see you in good health.

original: 当ったり前だろ？\nそう簡単に変わってたまるかっつーの
traducao: Of course I am!\nLike I'd go changing that easily.

original: にしても、お前\nよくこんなショボイ所に\n来る気になったよな
traducao: Even so, I'm surprised you felt\nlike coming to a shabby place\nlike this.

original: 金に困ったってわけじゃねーだろうし\n相変わらず物好きなんだな
traducao: It's not like you're hurting for cash,\nso you're as curious as ever, huh?

original: ルーク！　\n失礼でしょう
traducao: Luke!\nThat is beyond rude!

original: 殿下、ご無礼を申し訳ありません。\n後できつく言い聞かせますから……
traducao: Your Highness, forgive his rudeness.\nI will discipline him sternly later...

original: なに、気にする事はない
traducao: No need to fret over it.

original: ここは公式の場ではないのだし、\nそう畏まられても、私も困惑してしまう
traducao: This isn't an official venue, and such\nformality only puts me at a loss.

original: ですが……
traducao: But still...

original: だよなぁ？
traducao: See, what did I tell you?

original: へへっ。\n俺、お前のそういう\n堅苦しくねーとこ、楽で助かるわ
traducao: Heheh.\nI really appreciate that you're not\nall stiff and formal with me.

original: ここでは、そういった接し方の方が\n他の者にとっても、気が楽だろうと思ってね
traducao: I thought interacting this way would\nmake others feel more at ease here.

original: これからも、ギルドの一員として\nよろしく頼むよ。\nルーク君
traducao: I look forward to working with you\nas a fellow guild member,\nLuke.

original: ああ。\n任せとけって！
traducao: Yeah.\nLeave it to me!

original: ……頭が痛いわ……
traducao: ...My head hurts...

original: はい皆さ〜ん。\nここでクイズです〜
traducao: All right, everyone~!\nTime for a quiz~!

original: パンはパンでも食べられないパンとは、\n一体何でしょうか〜？
traducao: What kind of bread can you never eat,\nno matter what~?

original: なんだ。\nそんなの簡単だろ！
traducao: Come on.\nThat's way too easy!

original: あ、フライパンとか\n短パンはなしだからね！
traducao: Ah, frying pans and short pants\ndon't count, okay?!

original: 違う違う。\n食べられないのは、\nリフィル先生が作ったパンだよ！
traducao: No, no! The bread you can't eat\nis the bread made by\nProfessor Raine!

original: とてもじゃないけど、\n一口食べただけで……
traducao: Seriously, just one single bite,\nand you're...

original: な〜に言ってんだよ。\n口に入るだけましだろ！
traducao: What are you talking about?!\nAt least it fits in your mouth!

original: 食べられないパンってのは、\nアーチェが作ったパンだって
traducao: The bread you really can't eat\nis the bread Arche bakes!

original: 臭いからして、絶対無理だぜ……
traducao: Just from the smell, no way in hell...

original: お前ら、ほんっとわかってねぇなぁ！
traducao: You guys don't get it at all!

original: 食えねぇパンってのは、\nナタリアのパンだって
traducao: The bread that's truly inedible\nis the bread Natalia makes!

original: あいつの作ったのは、\n持ちたくないぐらい、\nすげぇパンなんだぞ！
traducao: What she makes is so terrifying,\nyou wouldn't even want to hold it\nin your hands!

original: ここまで言われる三人って……
traducao: To hear those three described like that...

original: でも、面白いからいいや∀
traducao: Well, it's hilarious, so whatever!

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

traducao: Laughter.\n

traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

traducao: Blushing.\n

traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

traducao: Heh.\n

traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

traducao: Rage.\n

traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.
